name: coe_stream_nth_rat_eq
statement: v = (↑q : K)) (n : ℕ) : ((IntFractPair.stream q n).map (mapFr (↑)) : Option <| IntFractPair K) = IntFractPair.stream v n

name: stream_succ_nth_fr_num_lt_nth_fr_num_rat
statement: IntFractPair ℚ} (stream_nth_eq : IntFractPair.stream q n = some ifp_n) (stream_succ_nth_eq : IntFractPair.stream q (n + 1) = some ifp_succ_n) : ifp_succ_n.fr.num < ifp_n.fr.num

name: stream_nth_fr_num_le_fr_num_sub_n_rat
statement: ∀ {ifp_n : IntFractPair ℚ}, IntFractPair.stream q n = some ifp_n → ifp_n.fr.num ≤ (IntFractPair.of q).fr.num - n

name: exists_nth_stream_eq_none_of_rat
statement: ℚ) : ∃ n : ℕ, IntFractPair.stream q n = none

name: terminates_iff_rat
statement: K) : (of v).Terminates ↔ ∃ q : ℚ, v = (q : K)
